content: This is what a blog post looks like in Markdown, and the HTML version which Google objects to. Every post has one of these. 16K+ posts since May 2017. That's all, just wanted to show you the A-B. You can also see what we're being influenced by in the front matter department. Having Claude helping with this I can get good insight into the defacto standards already established. Gives us a chance for more interop.
